findings.obligation: E10 (feature-delta, DESIGN D-6602 E10): compare SLE, states and ThroughputHistory between ATeam and a save of the same form
findings.observation: Quote: var setUpAtThePort = givens.ATeam("Team set up at the port", RefinementPortGivens.GravitysStates, throughputHistoryDays: 45, sleProbability: 85, sleRange: 7); and savedThroughItsSettings = givens.ATeam("Team saved through its settings", ..., throughputHistoryDays: 45, sleProbability: 85, sleRange: 7). Save path TeamExtensions.cs:42 and :57 writes ThroughputHistory and SLE from the DTO; the DTO is built from the stored team (TeamSettingDto(team, today)). The stored values already equal the sent values, so a save that omits SLE or ThroughputHistory still stores 85/7/45 and the comparison passes. The case can fail only on a destructive write, not on omission. The all-fields case therefore does not discriminate SLE or ThroughputHistory; the comment at lines 77-80 says they are given through the save.
findings.remediation: Start savedThroughItsSettings from a Team with different SLE and ThroughputHistory (e.g. 0 and 30), send 85/7/45 through the form, and compare WhatTheTeamStores. Keep one input per field; SLE and throughput are fields the form carries.
